additionalQualifications.qualification: Tabular RL is a contrast, not all non-deep RL. Named family examples are not inherently deep; model-based planning can use a supplied rather than learned model.
Illustrated action labels are schematic, not a validated Breakout action set; no question asks for literal game action availability.
Target freezing reduces moving-target coupling; no universal convergence guarantee or universal soft-update frequency is claimed.
Drone-vector units are not given and are not invented.
Publisher metadata says first online publication2024-10-07 and issueFebruary2025. Bibliographic title wording differs slightly; no author/date trivia is assessed.
Reward components are listed without event-priority/aggregation rules. Numerical aggregation questions declare their own hypothetical conventions.
Sample counts are not universal lower bounds, and reward density alone is not a sufficient cause of reward hacking.
